issues.display_title: Issue #4230: Implement Standalone Checkout Route and Moderator Redirect Handling
issues.main_description_html:
Demo by Developer

Screen.Recording.2026-09-02.150850.mp4

Feedback

Summary

Migrate the Unlock Moderation ("Hire GoThru to Connect Images") payment flow from an inline modal popup in TourDetail/TourTools.jsx into a Dedicated Page (e.g., /my-tours/:mid/unlock-moderation).

Unlike the public Unlock Overlay page, this route requires authentication (requires a valid user Auth Bearer Token). Additionally, for standalone page rendering, modal/popup entrance animations must be disabled.

Technical Context & Scope

  1. Routing (src/routes/myTours.js):

    • Add a dedicated child route under :mid: 
      {
  path: 'unlock-moderation',
  element: LazyLoad('Tour/Detail/UnlockModeration/UnlockModeration'),
}
    • Automatically protected under authenticated Layout and TourSocketProvider.

  2. Dedicated Page Component (src/pages/Tour/Detail/UnlockModeration/UnlockModeration.jsx):

    • Retrieve mid (Moderation ID) via useParams().
    • Validate tour details and access permissions using useTourDetails().
    • Render PaymentV2 (type="unlock_moderation", isOpen={true}, disableAnimation={true}) in standalone layout without modal popup animations.
    • Redirect to /404 or /my-tours if the tour is invalid or unauthorized.

  3. Cleanup in src/components/organism/TourDetail/TourTools.jsx:

    • Update HireToConnectImages action / confirmation to navigate directly to /my-tours/${mid}/unlock-moderation.
    • Remove legacy inline modal state (showPayment), local price fetching for moderation unlock, and show_unlock_moderation search parameter handling.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Route /my-tours/:mid/unlock-moderation is accessible only to authenticated users.
  • Dedicated page renders cleanly without modal popup / zoom / entrance animations (disableAnimation).
  • Unauthenticated users or users attempting to access unauthorized tours are handled gracefully (redirected to login or 404).
  • "Hire GoThru to Connect Images" trigger in Tour Tools navigates user to the dedicated page URL.
  • Product pricing, order details, and tax calculations from GET /v2/products/unlock-moderation render accurately on the dedicated page.
  • One-time payments via Stripe and PayPal execute successfully against POST /v2/payment/one-time/unlock-moderation ({ moderation_id, stripe_token }) / PayPal capture endpoint.
  • Payment status screens (success / failure) show tour details (business name, CID, total panoramas) with functional return link to /my-tours/:mid.
  • Cleaned up legacy inline PaymentV2 modal logic and show_unlock_moderation query parameter handling in TourTools.jsx.
